result.title: EG360: Efficient and Generalizable $360^\circ$ Depth Estimation via Adaptive Panorama-Perspective Distillation and Spherical Cross-Level Feature Fusion
result.summary: Generalized panorama depth estimation has witnessed great advances in recent years. These methods typically achieve robust zero-shot generalization performance using large pretrained models, but their high computational cost makes real-time inference on embedded platforms challenging. In contrast, previous lightweight panorama models have mostly been developed for single-domain evaluations and cannot generalize well due to domain shifts. To reduce the gap between these two types of models, we introduce EG360, an efficient and generalizable panorama depth estimation model. Specifically, building on a lightweight depth model, we design an Adaptive Panorama-Perspective Distillation (APPD) strategy guided by scene geometry, along with a Spherical Cross-Level Feature Fusion (SCFF) module for global semantic perception. As a result, with only 6.593M parameters after reparameterization, EG360 achieves strong zero-shot performance on real-world benchmarks and runs at 35 FPS on a Jetson Orin NX 16GB in MAXN mode, whereas a previous ViT-small model runs at less than 2 FPS. Our code will also be made public for future research.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 EG360，一个轻量可泛化的全景深度估计模型，通过场景几何引导的全景-透视蒸馏策略与球面跨层级特征融合模块，在约 6.6M 参数下实现零样本深度预测与嵌入式实时推理。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于全景深度估计的精度-效率折中工作，核心是蒸馏与多层级特征融合的密集预测网络，未涉及 latent 推理状态、视觉证据筛选、动态计算或停止决策，与 LVR 主线缺乏可核查的具体联系。
